about: Every OBP-API call OBP-OIDC makes: verb, path (OBP placeholders in capitals), the source file and the text that makes the call (needles), and the response fields the code reads. OBP-OIDC decodes most answers with circe, so every field a decoder requires is listed as a read, together with the optional fields the code uses. src/test/scala/com/tesobe/oidc/ObpApiContractTest.scala checks this list against the source and against snapshot.json, which obp-api-contract/snapshot.py writes from an OBP-API's resource docs. A call made from two files is listed once per file. OBP-OIDC builds no OBP-API path from user input. Not covered: OBP-OIDC can also read users and clients straight from Postgres views (v_oidc_users, v_oidc_clients, v_oidc_admin_clients) through doobie; that is not an HTTP contract and these tests do not check it.

calls.note: DirectLogin with the OIDC operator user (OBP_API_USERNAME); every other call sends the token.

Decoded into VerifyCredentialsResponse: user_id, username and provider are required; the rest are optional. OBP-API answers with JSONFactory200.createUserJSON, which has no first_name, last_name or is_validated (checked against OBP-API develop 474d4bc, 2026-11-13), so the user gets no name and no email_verified. On a 400 it shows the error's message.
Read as a list of strings.
user_id, username and provider are required; email is optional.
consent_request_id and client_id may be null; the consent callback compares both with the login it started.
Decoded into EntitlementInfo, so both fields are required. Called by checkRequiredRoles and checkUserRole.
Reachability only: OBP-OIDC reads the status code, not the body.

Decoded into VerifyClientResponse: valid is required; the rest are optional. OBP-API does not return grant_types yet (develop 474d4bc, 2026-11-13); without it OBP-OIDC allows every grant. On a 400 it shows the error's message.

Decoded into GetClientResponse: every field except grant_types is required, so a missing one makes the client unknown. OBP-API does not return grant_types yet (develop 474d4bc, 2026-11-13); without it OBP-OIDC allows every grant.
Decoded into ConsumerJson: redirect_url and created are optional, the rest required.
Decoded into CreateConsumerResponse: all ten fields are required.
Decoded into EntitlementInfo, so both fields are required.

Sent with the caller's Bearer token to guard the monitoring endpoints. OBP-OIDC reads a yes-or-no field, allowed, that OBP-API is to answer with once it drops auth modes. OBP-API develop 474d4bc (2026-11-13) still answers with allowed_for_auth_modes and no allowed, so OBP-OIDC refuses every token there. When OBP-API documents allowed, drop it from undocumented_fields.
